summary: Steep, narrow residential street with houses 6-12 m from the kerb all along.
reasons: Dwellings within 10 m along most of it
Narrow lane, no room to pull off

drivers.seclusion: Homes line both sides, several within 6-11 m of the kerb; dense gardens and trees but dwellings right there.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with garden edges and trees; little clear ground beside it, and the descent is steep.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Few parked cars seen; no sign of overnight parking here.

flags: Houses within 10 m (6 m at 134 m, 8 m at 8 m)
sun_shade: Heavily shaded by tree canopy, especially from 40 to 100 m.
